notes: Medical-visit preprocessing pipeline: stacks three per-visit datasets (RENAME + MDY dates), derives VAS_CAT (L/H), merges birthdates, then reports via PROC PRINT, two PROC MEANS (CLASS visit; WHERE VAS_CAT='L'), PROC TTEST on VAS, and PROC SQL inner/left joins with CASE WHEN counts. Only change vs upstream: the %import PROC IMPORT DBMS=XLS of external Visit1..Visit3.xls is replaced by inline DATALINES building the same raw per-visit columns (12/10/7 rows, values sampled from data/Visit1.xls); all author logic unchanged; ODS RTF paths made relative.
